headline: Russia Extends Jet Fuel Export Ban Through March 2027 Amid Refinery Strikes
summary: Russia extended its jet fuel export ban until March 31, 2027, as ongoing Ukrainian drone strikes on domestic refineries continue to constrain fuel output and suppress refining levels to multi-decade lows.
why: Russia is a major global exporter of petroleum and refined products. Export restrictions tighten global supplies and impact regional fuel markets.

impacts.name: Jet fuel
impacts.why: Extension of export ban restricts international supply of jet fuel due to domestic shortages.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Persistent drone strikes on domestic refineries reduced refining output, forcing authorities to extend export restrictions to cover domestic supply deficits.
